title: ISPR: 30 TTP Infiltrators Killed in Two-Night North Waziristan Border Battle
detail: Pakistani security forces detected and engaged a large group attempting to infiltrate from Afghanistan near Hassan Khel, North Waziristan, over the nights of July 1-2 and July 2-3, 2026, killing 30 Fitna al-Khawarij (TTP) militants and recovering weapons, ammunition, and explosives, ISPR announced on July 4.

sources.name: Express Tribune — Afghan border infiltration attempt foiled, 30 Khawarij terrorists killed: ISPR

media.caption: ISPR said 30 TTP infiltrators were killed over two nights of border fighting near Hassan Khel, North Waziristan.
